params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, {{cis|Ziggs}} next basic attack will deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, increased against {{tip|structures}}.
params.blurb2: ''Short Fuse's'' cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reduced}} whenever '''Ziggs''' casts an ability.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Ziggs''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to deal {{as|{{pp|16+4*x for 6; then +8*x for 6; then +12*x for 8|formula = 16 + 4 per level up to 6, then + 8 per level up to 12, then + 12 per level up to 18}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}},{{ft|increased by 75% against {{tip|structures}}.|increased to {{as|{{pp|1.75*(20+4*(x-1)) for 6;then +1.75*8*x for 6;then +1.75*12*x for 8|formula={{ap|20*1.75}} + {{ap|4*1.75}} per level up to 6, then + {{ap|8*1.75}} per level up to level 12, then + {{ap|12*1.75}} per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*1.75}}% AP)}} against {{tip|structures}}.}}
params.description2: ''Short Fuse's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{pp|4 to 6 for 3|1 to 13}} seconds whenever '''Ziggs''' casts an {{tip|ability}}.
params.speed: {{tt|1500|Attack missile speed, same as basic attacks}}
params.notes:
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|wards}}.
* The cooldown reduction is granted at the start of the abilities' cast time.
* ''Short Fuse'' will go on cooldown but not deal any damage if the attack misses due to {{tip|blind}}.
* {{Pending for test}}: ''Short Fuse's'' interactions with {{tip|dodge|dodging}} and {{tip|block|blocking}} effects.

blurb.plain: Innate: Periodically, Ziggs next basic attack will deal bonus magic damage, increased against structures.

blurb2.plain: Short Fuse's cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs casts an ability.

description.plain: Innate: Periodically, Ziggs empowers his next basic attack to deal ⟦pp⟧ (+ 50% AP) bonus magic damage,increased by 75% against structures.

description2.plain: Short Fuse's cooldown is reduced by 4 – 6 (based on level) seconds whenever Ziggs casts an ability.

speed.note: Attack missile speed, same as basic attacks

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ziggs}} throws a bomb to the target location that bounces twice forward. It will explode upon hitting an enemy, terrain, or the final bounce, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' throws a bomb to the target location that bounces forward up to two times, with the distance traveled each time being based on how far it was originally thrown and each bounce occurring over {{fd|0.495}} seconds regardless of distance.
params.description2: The bomb explodes upon landing near an enemy, within terrain, or the final bounce, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.range: {{tt|1400|Maximum range with bounces, excluding explosion radius}}
params.notes:
* ''Bouncing Bomb'' can be thrown or bounce over units/terrain.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage of the explosion, but the explosion can still damage other targets in the radius.
* '''Ziggs''' will throw the bomb from his location at the end of the cast time, towards the {{tt|pre-clamped|Relevant only if cast beyond maximum range}} cast location, causing the bounces to adjust their angle accordingly.

blurb.plain: Active: Ziggs throws a bomb to the target location that bounces twice forward. It will explode upon hitting an enemy, terrain, or the final bounce, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

description.plain: Active: Ziggs throws a bomb to the target location that bounces forward up to two times, with the distance traveled each time being based on how far it was originally thrown and each bounce occurring over 0.495 seconds regardless of distance.

description2.plain: The bomb explodes upon landing near an enemy, within terrain, or the final bounce, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

range.note: Maximum range with bounces, excluding explosion radius

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ziggs}} hurls a charge to the target location that remains for a few seconds. ''Satchel Charge'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} The charge explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knock back}} nearby enemies hit. If this hits '''Ziggs''', he will {{tip|dash}} farther away.
params.blurb3: The explosion will {{tip|execute}} {{tip|turrets}} hit {{as|below a certain health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' hurls a charge to the target location, remaining there for 4 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area. ''Satchel Charge'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. If recast while in flight, the charge will explode immediately upon landing.
params.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ziggs''' detonates the charge, causing it to explode to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} over {{fd|0.5}} seconds up to 500 units away from the center of the explosion, though not through terrain. If this hits '''Ziggs''', he will {{tip|dash}} up to 825 units away from the center.
params.description3: {{cci|Satchel Charge Turret Explosion Indicator.png|border=false||{{sbc|Turret Explosion:}}}} The explosion also {{ccs|{{tip|execute|executes}}|magic}} enemy {{tip|turrets}} within that are below a {{as|'''maximum''' health}} threshold.
params.description4: '''''Ziggs''' will not {{tip|dash}} from the explosion if he is {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|325|Satchel explosion radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly = true}}{{tt|400|Satchel sight radius}}}}
params.outofrange: Walk in range of the target location to cast (first cast)
params.notes:
*The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
**Detonating the ability manually does not.
* Deals {{tip|area damage}} to non-turrets and {{tip|raw damage}} to turrets.
* ''Satchel Charge's'' distance increases with proximity to the charge, resulting in being knocked straight up when aligned directly on top of it.
* '''Ziggs''' will not ''dash'' from ''Satchel Charge's'' detonation while {{si|Teleport|Teleporting}} but he will while {{si|Recall|Recalling}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Ziggs hurls a charge to the target location that remains for a few seconds. Satchel Charge can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.

blurb2.plain: Recast: The charge explodes to deal magic damage and knock back nearby enemies hit. If this hits Ziggs, he will dash farther away.

blurb3.plain: The explosion will execute turrets hit below a certain health.

description.plain: Active: Ziggs hurls a charge to the target location, remaining there for 4 seconds and granting sight of the area. Satchel Charge can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. If recast while in flight, the charge will explode immediately upon landing.

description2.plain: Recast: Ziggs detonates the charge, causing it to explode to deal magic damage to nearby enemies and knock them back over 0.5 seconds up to 500 units away from the center of the explosion, though not through terrain. If this hits Ziggs, he will dash up to 825 units away from the center.

description3.plain: ⟦cci⟧ The explosion also executes enemy turrets within that are below a maximum health threshold.

description4.plain: Ziggs will not dash from the explosion if he is immobilized or grounded. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ziggs}} scatters proximity mines over the target location that remain a period. Each mine will explode upon contact with an enemy or terrain, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} them.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' scatters a cluster of 11 proximity mines over the target location that grant {{tip|sight}} of the area for 2 seconds, {{tt|arming after {{fd|0.5}} seconds|travel time of the mines spreading out plus a brief delay}} and lasting for up to 10 seconds.
params.description2: Each mine within the area explodes upon contact with terrain or an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around the explosion for 2 seconds. An enemy takes 40% damage from subsequent mines.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|335|Effective minefield radius}}|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|135|Detection and explosion radius of each individual mine}}}}
params.notes:
* The mine cluster is built of 2 rings, with 3 mines in the inner ring (radius pending for test) and 8 mines on the other ring (200 radius), all equally spaced.
** The angular offset is randomized on each cast.
** Because of the {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 135 detonation radius of each mine, the total possible range of a mine from the minefield hitting an enemy from the cast location is {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 335 units. It will often be slightly less as the minefield is not guaranteed to be angled the right way for this.
* Mines will not explode upon contact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the effects of a single detonation.

blurb.plain: Active: Ziggs scatters proximity mines over the target location that remain a period. Each mine will explode upon contact with an enemy or terrain, dealing magic damage and briefly slowing them.

description.plain: Active: Ziggs scatters a cluster of 11 proximity mines over the target location that grant sight of the area for 2 seconds, arming after 0.5 seconds and lasting for up to 10 seconds.

description2.plain: Each mine within the area explodes upon contact with terrain or an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing them for 1.5 seconds, as well as granting sight of the area around the explosion for 2 seconds. An enemy takes 40% damage from subsequent mines.

variants.label: Detection and explosion radius of each individual mine

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ziggs}} catapults the ''Mega Inferno Bomb'' to the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, increased at the epicenter.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' catapults the ''Mega Inferno Bomb'' to the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 4 seconds.
params.description2: The bomb explodes upon arrival to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 65% against those outside of the epicenter.
params.leveling2: {{st|Epicenter Magic Damage|{{ap|300 to 700|round=2}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|300*0.65 to 700*0.65}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.65}}% AP)}}}}
params.notes:
* Allies cannot see ''Mega Inferno Bomb's'' area indicator until shortly before the blast.
* ''Mega Inferno Bomb'' takes {{fd|2.64}} seconds from the start of the cast time to land when cast at maximum range (reduced to {{fd|1.617}} seconds from the start of the cast time when casting within {{tt|2700|Estimated}} units).
** When cast within 2700 units, ''Mega Inferno Bomb'' has a fixed travel time. Beyond that, the travel time is equal to the cast distance divided by the now-fixed missile speed.
* The area reveal on the target location begins as soon as the cast time is completed and can see into {{tip|brush}} and across terrain.

blurb.plain: Active: Ziggs catapults the Mega Inferno Bomb to the target location that deals magic damage to enemies hit, increased at the epicenter.

description.plain: Active: Ziggs catapults the Mega Inferno Bomb to the target location, granting sight of the area for 4 seconds.

description2.plain: The bomb explodes upon arrival to deal magic damage to enemies hit, reduced to 65% against those outside of the epicenter.
